label: F-Secure: Total Security & VPN
description_long:
**F-Secure all-in-one security makes online protection easy**   
Get antivirus, scam protection, VPN, password management, and identity protection in one app. Choose the protection that matches your needs.   
  
**Sign up in the app and get Mobile security subscription 14 days free.**  
  
**Mobile security subscription: security on the go**  
✓ Download apps and files safely to your device with top-rated antivirus.  
✓ No more guessing – detect phishing websites and fake online stores automatically on Chrome browser.  
✓ Keep your money safe when banking, browsing, and shopping online.   
✓ Spot scams with Scam Scanner — upload a screenshot of anything suspicious and find out if it’s a scam.  
✓ SMS Protection – Filter scam SMS messages instantly with AI-powered SMS protection.  
✓ Connect to any WiFi hotspot securely with a VPN and make your browsing private.   
✓ Prevent identity theft with 24/7 dark web monitoring and data breach alerts.  
✓ Manage your privacy and app permissions easily in one location.  
✓ Get useful tips on setting up device lock and activating security features.  
  
**Total subscription: complete protection on all devices**  
✓ Everything included in Mobile security plus all the following benefits.  
✓ Store and access passwords from any device with a password manager.   
✓ Protect your kids’ safety online with content filtering and healthy screentime limits.  
✓ Protect all your PC, Mac, Android and iOS devices against cyber threats with one subscription.  
  
**F‑Secure VPN subscription**  
If you only want to guard your privacy, you can get the F‑Secure VPN subscription. With it you only pay for F‑Secure VPN that allows you to browse privately, join any Wi-Fi hotspot safely, and change your IP address.  
  
**Secure everything you do online**  
F-Secure makes protecting everything you do online easy – whether it’s streaming your favorite show, connecting with family, managing your money, or saving priceless memories. Everything you need is in one app. Get antivirus, VPN, password vault, data breach alerts and more with the subscription that best suits your needs.  
  
DATA PRIVACY COMPLIANCE   
F-Secure always applies strict security measures to protect the confidentiality and integrity of your personal data. See the full privacy policy here: https://www.f-secure.com/en/legal/privacy/consumer/total  
  
THIS APP USES ACCESSIBILITY SERVICES  
This app uses Accessibility services. F-Secure uses the respective permissions with active consent from the end user.   
  
The Accessibility permissions are used for the Chrome Protection features, in particular:  
• To read website addresses for checking their safety on Chrome.  
  
With the Accessibility service   
• safety checks on Chrome can be performed.

inferences.reasoning: The feature explicitly involves connecting to Wi-Fi hotspots, routing internet traffic for private browsing, and changing the user's IP address, which directly corresponds to permissions handling IP-based data transport, global internet routing, and Wi-Fi interface states.

Maintaining a persistent secure VPN connection typically requires the application to run a specialized foreground service to prevent the system from terminating the network tunnel when the app is not in the foreground.

features.title: Dark Web Monitoring & Breach Alerts
features.description: Provides 24/7 monitoring of the dark web to prevent identity theft and sends data breach alerts.

inferences.reasoning: The feature explicitly states it 'sends data breach alerts' to users, which requires notification permissions to display breach alert notifications.
The dark web monitoring service requires internet connectivity to communicate with external monitoring services and check for data breaches.

features.title: Privacy & App Permission Management
features.description: Offers a centralized location to manage user privacy settings and application permissions.

inferences.reasoning: Managing application permissions and privacy settings requires access to control application lifecycle, manage package configurations, and adjust system resource optimization, which falls under application and system management capabilities.
Handling user privacy settings may require permissions related to system security integrations.

features.title: Security Configuration Guidance
features.description: Provides tips for setting up device locks and activating other security features.

inferences.reasoning: The feature provides informational tips and guidance on security settings. It does not explicitly require accessing sensitive user data, reading device status, or modifying system configurations programmatically, which would necessitate specific permission groups. Displaying text-based guidance and potentially opening system settings via standard intents does not require granted permissions.

The feature involves providing guidance for device security configurations, which may require permissions related to system security integrations, credential management, or biometric authentication, all of which fall under this group.

features.title: Cross-Device Password Manager
features.description: Enables users to store and access passwords from any device using an integrated password manager.

inferences.reasoning: Required for 'Cross-Device' functionality to synchronize password data across multiple devices via the internet.
Required to secure the password vault using biometric authentication (fingerprint/face) and to prevent screen capturing of sensitive data.
Potentially required for backing up password data to external files or importing/exporting password lists.
Required to configure and manage sync settings for the password manager across devices.

features.title: Parental Controls (Content Filtering & Screen Time)
features.description: Protects children online through content filtering and screen time limit management.

inferences.reasoning: Content filtering requires monitoring, blocking, or managing IP-based data transport and internet routing to restrict access to specific online content.
Screen time management necessitates retrieving task states and managing package installation states to identify which applications are active and enforce usage limits.
Enforcing screen time limits typically requires setting exact alarms to wake the device, and blocking content may involve drawing window overlays to restrict access.
Advanced content filtering may require reading screen content to detect prohibited text or images, and tracking specific user interactions for granular usage monitoring.
The system needs to post notifications to inform parents or children when time limits are reached or when content has been filtered.
Required to launch specialized foreground services for continuous monitoring and enforcement of screen time limits and content filtering rules.

features.title: Multi-Platform Device Coverage
features.description: Provides protection across PC, Mac, Android, and iOS devices via a single subscription.

inferences.reasoning: No permission required. This feature describes cross-platform subscription coverage and does not specify any functionality that requires access to device hardware, data, or system features.

features.title: Accessibility Service Integration for Safety Checks
features.description: Uses Accessibility services to read website addresses for safety checking on Chrome browsers.

inferences.reasoning: The feature explicitly utilizes Accessibility services to read screen content (specifically website addresses), which directly maps to the permissions defined in this group for reading screen content through assistant structures.
